(847)rdo rjechos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la mngon par bstod pa tshangs pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/na ma shri badzra dharma bā la ye/tshangs pa mgrin

tei:div.tei:p: rdo rjechos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la mngon par bstod pa tshangs pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na ma shri badzra dharma bā la ye/ tshangs pa mgrin sngon khyab 'jug dang ni dbang po nye dbang btsun mor bcas/ lha chen kun gyis mngon par bstod pa dpal ldan rdo rje nag po che/ lha min tshogs dang lha min yid can bstan dgra ma lus brlag mjad pa/ he ru ka yi sprul pa mchog gyur kro ti yum gyi bdag por 'dud/ lha yi lhar gyur che (848)ba'i mchog ldan bdag med rdo rje khros pa'i gar/ bdag 'jin ru tra'i snying khrag rngub mjad 'jigs rung rdo rje srin po'i gzugs/ 'jigs dus me dpung 'bum gyi gzi ldan 'chol ba'i khro rgyal ma ning nag bdud sde'i gshed gyur lha chen dpal 'bar chos skyong yongs kyi rgyal por bstod/ snying rje'i dbang phyug snying rjes khros gang 'jigs dus sprin gyi gzugs ldan pa/ dran pa'i mdo la bdud sde'i don snying lkog mar 'byin mjad nag po che/ 'bum phrag bskal (849)pa'i me chen 'khyil dbus sdig can bstan dgra'i snying gar ni/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol par mjad pa dpal mgon tshogs kyi bdag por 'dud/ khros pa'i zhal gyi sprin nag 'khrigs las sdang mig glog zhags rnam g.yo zhing*/ tshems kyi myu gu gangs ri'i mdangs 'jin skyin thang zor gyis dgra la 'bebs/ lcags kyi sder mo gnam lcags 'bar bas nyams pa'i tsitta drung 'byin pa'i/ srid rgyal ma zhes sngags srung gtso mo nam mkha'i (850)ral gcig 'jin la bstod/ srid gsum gnas kun yud kyis nyul zhing sdig can bstan dgra'i snying srog la/ 'jigs pa'i drag shul rdo rje'i thog char thog med mthu yis 'bebs mjad ma/ snang srid dbang bsgyur mkha' 'gro'i shul rdo rje'i thog char thog med mthu yis 'bebs mjad ma/ snang srid dbang bsgyur mkha' 'gro'i rje mo phrin las rnam bzhi'i zlos gar can/

re ma ti zhes bstan srung rgyal mo snang srid ma mo 'khor bcas bsngags/ srid zh-i mjes sdug snying por bsdus 'dra yid 'ong zla ba'i zhal gyi khyim/ tshe g.yang 'dod rgu mi zad 'jo ba'i 'jum dkar snang ba'i (851)dga' ston cing*/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde chen ster mjad lhan skyes gsang ba'i ḍā ki nī/ zhing skyong sman btsun rgyal mo'i tshul ston mched lnga sprul pa bcas la 'dud/ gnod sbyin gter gyi rgya mtsho che las dgos 'dod nor bu'i mchog sbyin pa'i/ rnam mang thos sras lha mor bcas pa gang dag bu mang ldan pa'i tshogs/ thugs rje'i gdeng ka rnam par g.yo zhing byams pa'i phyag gis nyug mjad pa/ de dag kun la gus pas 'dud do 'bru nor (852)longs spyod char ltar phob/ las byed mon pa'i rlung nag dang 'grogs sbud pa'i gzugs dang rdo rje'i mda'/ lhan cig rbad pas dgra snying gtor zhing dgra bo'i glad pa 'gem mjad pa'i/ sgrol ging las kyi bshan pa mchog dang dam can ma mo ngan nge ma/ dkor nor srung ba'i byed po kun la rab tu dang bas bdag phyag 'tshal/ sdig can dgra bo'i snying khrag rdzing bur mi sdug gzugs kyi tshang tshing 'khrigs/ srid gsum srog dbugs gcig char rngub pa'i lto zhal 'jigs rung (853)mkha' la gdeng*/ legs nyes 'byed pa'i spyan stong bgrad las dam nyams snying la dug char 'bebs/ gsang bdag dpa' bo'i bka' sdod mthu chen 'jigs mjad rā hu la la 'dud/ 'bum phrag bskal pa'i me yis 'khyud pa nag po brtsegs pa'i ri dbang gzugs/ drag shul dug rlang sa gsum khyab mjad 'jigs pa'i dus kyi sgra dbyangs can/ srid gsum ma lus rdul du bshig pa rdo rje'i be con rngams stabs gdengs/ khams gsum srid gsum ma lus rdul du bshig pa rdo rje'i be con rngams stabs gdengs/ khams gsum (854)srog dbugs gang gis sdud pa 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rjer bstod/

mi shig rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs ldan ldog med rdo rje btsun po'i mthu/ rdo rje'i ri dbang 'bum gyi brjid 'dra rgyal 'gong dam sri'i srog snying la/ rdul ba'i brag la gnam lcags thog bzhin bzod par dka' ba'i ngang tshul can/ sa brgyad sems dpa' yul lha'i tshul ston rdo rje 'bar ba de la bsngags/ mchog du zhi ba snying rje'i thugs ldan zla gzhon bye ba'i 'jug dkar can/ 'dod dgu'i mchog (855)rtsol nor bu'i sprin chen yid bzhin dbang gi glog dmar 'khyug bdud sde'i srog rtsa dum bur 'thor byed phrin las drag po'i thog char 'bebs/ dran pa'i mdo la phyogs las rnam rgyal don grub dgra bla'i rgyal por bstod/ gang bcol phrin las yun gyis sgrub pa dbang drag glog gi zlos gar 'bum/ dam ldan yid mkhar mngon par rtsen las srid gsum bstan pa 'phrog byed pa/ dbang chen rol pa gsung gi bstan srung che btsan rgyal po mchod bdun dang*/ (856)srid pa gsum po yongs kyi rje gyur mchog gi dbang phyug bcas la 'dud/ brgyud gsum bla ma'i dam tshig gnyer 'jin bla med bka' yi bya ra ba/ sdang mig gcig gis srid gsum brlag nus mi bzad drag po'i stobs shugs 'chang*/ rig stong gdod ma'i rtsal las mngon snang dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang*/ sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad la sogs sde gsum srung ma rgya mtshor bstod/ dag mnyam chen po lta ba'i dbyings su sgom pa'i gzi byin rab bskyed de/ rdo rje'i tha (857)tshig snying la bsgrags cing ro mnyam phyag rgyas rgyas btab nas/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs mchod pa'i rol mos bstan srung rgya mtsho mnga' gsol na/ brgyud gsum bla ma'i dam tshig dgongs la bstan dang bstan 'jin skyong bar mjod/ dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs yi dam dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs/ mkha' 'gro'i phrin las 'bras bur g.yur za chos skyong srung ma'i ra ba brtan/

dus gsum dge ba'i bkra shis g.yang 'khyil phun (858)tshogs phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i/ g.yar dam gnyan po 'grub par mjod cig skyabs 'os rnams kyis mthun 'gyur mjod/ cesardo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams la mngon par bstod cing mnga' gsol ba 'di ni rgyud mgon dang ma gza' dam can rnam sras kyi bstod pa dang 'jug gi tshig bcad bcas rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi dpung por bzhag las/ lhag ma'i tshigs bcad rnams mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas kha bskang pa ste/ 'dis kyang bstan dgra ma lus pa tshar gcod cing bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan chen po srid rtser bsgreng ba'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga laṃ/// /
